store_catalogue._apparel_doc: Bella's apparel options per design, captured from her public Silent Touch storefront on 2026-10-22. Keys are the category slugs used by the category tiles and data-gcat (see `categories` for their labels). Coverage is the store's own category filters (?category=hoodie / sweatshirt / long_sleeve / tank_top / hats, which list one product per design) plus the individual t-shirt listings on each design. Every garment name and `price_usd` was verified directly on the live store in USD; `image` is the listing's HMAC-signed w:500 mockup URL copied verbatim and `url` opens that exact listing with its productId (the build adds Bella's referral parameters).
